data.completion_memo: Implemented the replaceable graph-surface port and adapter, rendering selected workflow nodes with viewport-oriented bounded rendering and translating selection gestures back to kernel intents.
data.description: Implement the React Flow adapter behind WorkflowGraphSurfacePort: render the editor kernel's nodes, typed ports, transitions, cycles, self-loops, multi-edges, groups, selection, viewport, and palette drag/drop; translate surface gestures into existing typed edit commands; and apply viewport culling. Reuse the design-system interaction primitives and kernel-supplied property/action/accessibility models rather than reimplementing them inside the adapter.
data.title: M07.6 — Implement the replaceable workflow graph-surface adapter
